'''Jirritt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] and the brother of warrior and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Gaarkhan/Legends|Gaarkhan]].<ref name="Indebted" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Jirritt, accompanied by another Wookiee<ref name="Indebted" /> named [[Shortatha]]<ref name="Campaign Guide">{{SWIA|set=Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set|text=Core Set|}} {{C|Campaign Guide}}</ref> to whom Jirritt swore a [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]], was ambushed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]]. The ambush resulted in Jirritt's [[Death/Legends|death]] and Shortatha's capture. In order to honor his brother's debt, Gaarkhan traveled to<ref name="Indebted" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="TTABSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] to free the [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]] Wookiee.<ref name="Indebted" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jirritt was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' [[Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set|Core Set]]<ref name="Indebted" /> released on [[December 15]], [[2014]],<ref name="Begin Your Assault">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/12/15/begin-your-assault|text=Begin Your Assault}}</ref> on the card "[https://imperial-assault.fandom.com/wiki/Indebted Indebted]" illustrated by [[Jason Juta]].<ref name="Indebted" />
